articles.title: Lance Broadway passes away at age 43, pitcher-turned-actor found dead at stairwell in Dallas apartment complex
articles.description: Lance Broadway, who was both a major league pitcher and an actor, passed away at age 43. His death occurred in a stairwell at an apartment complex near Love Field Airport. The Dallas County Medical Examiner's Office reported his death but the cause remains unclear. Broadway pitched at Dallas Baptist and Texas Christian before being drafted first by the Chicago White Sox.
